summary: Max Verstappen's dominant qualifying performance has cemented Red Bull as the team to beat heading into Sunday's race, with even Lewis Hamilton acknowledging the reigning champion's formidable pace advantage in the roasting heat of Malaysia. George Russell and Charles Leclerc will hunt for a chink in Red Bull's armor, but the upgraded machinery has left Ferrari and Mercedes scrambling to close a significant performance gap. A commanding victory for Verstappen would extend his championship lead significantly, while a Hamilton or Leclerc triumph would inject fresh momentum into what shapes as a tight title fight heading into the final races.
